pr_body:
If merged this will close #18788.

Testcase:

```diff
diff --git a/mods/d2k/rules/world.yaml b/mods/d2k/rules/world.yaml
index 2029bd603..3e5d7a01b 100644
--- a/mods/d2k/rules/world.yaml
+++ b/mods/d2k/rules/world.yaml
@@ -133,6 +133,7 @@ World:
                ProductionPaletteWidget: PRODUCTION_PALETTE
        ActorSpawnManager:
                Actors: sandworm
+               SpawnInterval: 2000, 8000
        CrateSpawner:
                Minimum: 0
                Maximum: 2
```

issue_context.title: Change the interval of ActorSpawnManager from single number to a two value interval.
issue_context.body: That way the engine picks a random value between both if listed.

review_comments: The `\n` is not strictly necessary, can remove it if we want.
